post.summary: Initiate secret rotation for the calling app
post.description: Initiates an app secret rotation for the calling app. Needs to be called with an integration token belonging to an app. Note that the secret rotation will only be scheduled and then handled asynchronously.

202.description: Returns "Accepted" when secret rotation was scheduled.

400.description: Malformed request, e.g. when requested with non app integration source.

403.description: Forbidden. Not a valid integration source.
